headline: Why is My Toilet Running Constantly?
articleBody: Hearing your toilet run non-stop can be super annoying, and it's also a big waste of water. Usually, when your toilet keeps running, it’s a sign that one of the internal components in the tank isn't quite doing its job right. Most often, it's a worn-out flapper that isn't sealing properly, allowing water to continuously trickle into the bowl. Sometimes, it could be a fill valve that's set too high, causing water to overflow into the toilet's overflow tube. These small issues can add up to a significant increase in your water bill over time, so it's definitely something you want to get checked out. Trying to fix it yourself might seem like a good idea, but getting it wrong can lead to more complex problems or even leaks. If you've tried the basic adjustments and it's still running, it's a good idea to call in a professional.
